extraction_text: In accordance with Article III, Section 1 and 2, the Company may establish new classifications to cover new or changed equipment, methods or processes; changes in job duties; or for purposes of reducing production costs. Classifications will not be instituted for the primary purposes of nullifying seniority provisions or reducing employee earnings.

Salaried personnel are responsible for developing and maintaining programs associated with programmable controllers. Unless there are extenuating circumstances, salaried personnel will not perform controller repairs except for purposes of instruction.
